contract: The pre-normalization semantic-intent assertion uses the same canonical candidate scope projection as post-normalization and prospective evaluation.
Rendered future-default scope remains authored and unchanged; a complete authenticated nondefault PR binding derives pr progress only.
An asserted protected phase/workitem/closure intent or incomplete nondefault binding rejects before lease/reconciliation.
Pass the independently resolved context into normalization; recapture fresh context/subject after canonical generation.
No new CLI intent/default, protected-main progress or certification authority is introduced.
tests: nondefault pr assertion accepted while authored default scope is closure
nondefault closure assertion rejected before lease
unchanged default assertions and canonical derived-state behavior
